title: Tree of Light — names for the scroll
body: St James's Church, Harvington, holds its Tree of Light service at 6.30pm on Monday 2 November (All Souls' Day), when the tree lights are switched on. To have a loved one's name written on the commemorative scroll in the church's Prayer Corner, contact Elliot Grainger at Langton House, 19 Village Street, Harvington, or elliot@barfieldgrainger.com.
